observation: The controlling ChatGPT thread must not become a second instruction channel. Any human action, next step, warning, retry, wait condition, or route-back instruction given here must also exist in Primary Chat first or in the same durable projection update.
rules: Primary Chat is the canonical human-facing instruction surface.
This ChatGPT thread may observe, critique, debug and temporarily bootstrap missing capabilities, but must not ask the human to do something that is absent from Primary Chat.
If a new human action becomes necessary, publish/update Primary Chat before or atomically with telling the human here.
If Primary Chat cannot be updated, report NO_ACTION here unless the situation is a true emergency/authority boundary; then explicitly mark CHANNEL_PARITY_BROKEN and repair it immediately.
Actions shown in Primary Chat must supersede stale actions rather than accumulate contradictory instructions.
A future private bridge should make Primary Chat both the read and write surface; until then, this thread is a shadow control/debug channel.
success_test: At any point, the human can ignore the controlling ChatGPT thread and still know exactly what to do next from Primary Chat alone.
